name: rocm_aiter_mla_dcp_verify_96_heads
changes: _asm_dcp_verify_heads keeps 96 DCP-gathered heads (no pad to 128) when the KV cache is fp8 and 1+num_speculative_tokens <= 6. AITER asm_mla.cu (v0.1.24.post1) dispatches gfx950 fp8 persistent gqa 96 at qlen<=6 to the same mla_a8w8_qh32_qseqlen4_gqaratio32[_lse]_cprr_ps kernel as gqa 128, so the pad only adds work: DSpark4 verify packs 96x5=480 rows (4 tiles of 128) instead of 128x5=640 (5 tiles)

Local gfx950 check (aiter 0.1.21.post2, same dispatch): 96-head output/LSE bit-identical to the first 96 heads of the padded 128-head run; both 1.9% rel. L2 vs an fp32 round-robin reference (mla96/cprr96_check.py)
DSpark draft layers are non-causal (PLAIN route) and never use cprr; only their metadata sizing follows the 96-head count
